description.value: Rio Brazilian Steakhouse is a family-owned churrascaria steps from English Bay serving all-you-can-eat rodizio-style Brazilian barbecue since 2012. Gaucho-style servers carve meats tableside from skewers alongside a fresh salad bar and hot sides, with live Samba shows on Fridays. Its Denman Street location puts it directly on one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors near the Stanley Park seawall.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 55m; stands (6 spaces) at 62m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags and website content both confirm the Vancouver location at 1122 Denman Street with phone (604) 568-7722, and the website is active with 2024-2025 blog posts. The website explicitly advertises a 'Take Out Menu | Delivery' section with a full menu, and states 'It's a Gluten-Free Paradise,' confirming GF options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is well-located on a major cycling corridor near the Stanley Park seawall and offers takeout, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification of at minimum bike parking and washrooms is needed before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'It's a Gluten-Free Paradise'; menu includes multiple salad and vegetable side options including spicy tofu salad
